sections.abstract:
A year-long randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of simvastatin to see if it produces beneficial changes in cerebral spinal fluid proteins associated with Alzheimer's disease.

Posted outcomes: Change From Baseline in Aβ42 in Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) at 1 Year. timeframe=1-year change of CSF Aβ42 from baseline. Placebo=5.3 (±31); Simvastatin=0.5 (±42). p=0.53
